cases.text: g4 spends a pawn move that Ke3 keeps available. After Ke3 f6, the tested Kf3 evaluates above an immediate g4. In the recorded king manoeuvre, Kf3 Kd6 Ke2 Ke5 Ke3 restores the same piece placement with Black to move, while the pawn stays on g3. The king manoeuvre hands over the move without spending the pawn advance.
